column1: # Used by the `catalog` backend on every platform that lacks BlackArch's pacman
# groups (Debian, Ubuntu, Kali, Parrot, Fedora, openSUSE, Alpine, macOS, WSL).
# A row is shown in the menu only if its <binary> resolves on PATH, so it never
# matters HOW the tool was installed (apt, dnf, pipx, go, cargo, a raw tarball)
# — if it runs, it appears; if it isn't installed, it's silently skipped.
# Categories must match a token in data/sections.conf.
# This is a curated set of the tools people actually reach for, not an attempt
# to mirror all 4000+ BlackArch packages. To add your own, append a line — see
# docs/ADDING-TOOLS.md. Keep it sorted by category for readability.
